title: Session rollup over-counts one user's visits
summary: The per-user session count Growth reads each morning reports one user with more sessions than the product analytics dashboard, a single boundary click away from misreading a returning user as a power user.
task: Group each user's overnight clicks into sessions and report how many sessions each user had, so the rollup agrees with the product analytics dashboard Growth compares it against.

company.notes: Sessionization over an inactivity gap; an order-dependent boundary comparison error, no syntax fault and no crash.

expected_output:
=== sessions per user (gap 1800s) ===
alice: 2
bob: 1
carol: 1
dan: 2
buggy_output:
=== sessions per user (gap 1800s) ===
alice: 2
bob: 2
carol: 1
dan: 2

phase2.spec_patch: Ops now wants the session counts split by platform, because a user active on web and on mobile in the same minutes is really two concurrent sessions, not one. Print each row as `user/platform: <sessions>` and keep the rows sorted. The platform column is already in the feed today.
phase2.expected_output_v2:
=== sessions per user and platform (gap 1800s) ===
alice/mobile: 2
alice/web: 2
bob/web: 1
carol/web: 1
dan/web: 2
